title: Battery Demand Updates - Benchmark Summit 2026 London
gist: This is a member-only video page for Benchmark senior analyst Zoe Zhang's battery demand update at Benchmark Summit 2026 London. It has no transcript or demand figures, only titles and blurbs for related sessions on Chinese OEMs in Europe's EV market, Texas Smackover lithium, Los Azules copper, rare earths and UK industrial power costs.

insights.claim: Benchmark senior analyst Zoe Zhang presented a battery demand update at Benchmark Summit 2026 London on Oct 22, 2026. The video page is member-only and gives no demand figures or forecasts.
insights.speaker: Zoe Zhang, Senior analyst, Benchmark
insights.so_what: Benchmark's latest battery demand numbers exist but are not public; members would need the video to update demand assumptions.
insights.locator: Battery Demand Updates - Benchmark Summit 2026 London

insights.claim: Benchmark's related-session listing says the role of Chinese OEMs in Europe's growing EV market is a topic of increasing interest, with senior EV analyst George Whitcombe discussing it with senior editor Matthew Bird.
insights.speaker: Zoe Zhang, Senior analyst, Benchmark
insights.so_what: Chinese OEM share gains in European EVs are a watch item for European automakers and for which regions the battery supply chain serves.
insights.quote: The role of Chinese OEMs in Europe's growing EV market is a topic of increasing interest.
insights.locator: China's role in Europe EV market

themes.theme: Summit agenda: supply and industrial competitiveness

insights.claim: Benchmark Summit 2026 London had a keynote billing the Texas Smackover as "America's Lithium Leviathan", which presents the Smackover brine as a major prospective source of US domestic lithium supply.
insights.speaker: Zoe Zhang, Senior analyst, Benchmark
insights.so_what: US brine lithium from the Smackover is being pitched as a large domestic supply source, which is worth tracking for North American lithium project developers.
insights.quote: The Texas Smackover: America's Lithium Leviathan

insights.claim: Benchmark Summit 2026 London had a fireside chat on rare earths framed as investing in strategic assets and unlocking value, which treats rare earths as a strategic-asset investment theme.
insights.speaker: Zoe Zhang, Senior analyst, Benchmark
insights.so_what: Rare earths are being pitched to investors as strategic assets, so rare-earth project financing is a theme to monitor.
insights.quote: Rare Earths - Investing in strategic assets and unlocking value

insights.claim: A Benchmark Summit 2026 London keynote by Regional Power Pavilions asks whether British industry can stay competitive when one of its biggest costs, power, is also its least predictable.
insights.speaker: Zoe Zhang, Senior analyst, Benchmark
insights.so_what: Volatile UK power prices are framed as a competitiveness risk for energy-intensive UK battery and materials manufacturing.
insights.quote: Can British industry remain competitive when one of its biggest costs is its least predictable?
insights.locator: Keynote Presentation: Introducing Regional Power Pavilions
